name: Moon Child (Legendary Druid Archetype)
body:
A child born under the right signs can be touched with their own unique connection to the primal world. They are the chosen of nature who will make nature’s will their own.

Skills: The moonchild adds Intimidate to their class skill list. This modifies skills.

Moon Magic: The moonchild uses their Charisma, rather than their Wisdom, to determine all class features and effects relating to their legendary druid class, such as bonus spells per day, the maximum spell level you can cast, and the save DCs of their spells.

Force of Personality

At 1st level, the moonchild can use their Charisma modifier in place of their Wisdom modifier for their Will saving throws.

Druidic Talents

The following talents are available to moonchildren:

Deep Connection (Ex)

The moonchild may use Charisma in place of Intelligence on Knowledge (nature) checks.
